page_title: NEW 4-1 MNU | Newcastle v Manchester Utd 13/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Chris Kavanagh is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

90+4' A great run by Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Manchester Utd try to maintain the tempo of the game by taking a quick free kick.

90+2' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Chris Kavanagh stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. It's a free kick to Manchester Utd, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

90' A long cross into the box finds Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) unmarked, but his header from the edge of the six-yard box is wild and goes miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
89' Newcastle take a quick free kick with a short pass and play continues.
89' Rough tackle by Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Newcastle are awarded a free kick.
87' Poor challenge! Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) is penalised for tripping and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle. Newcastle have been awarded a free kick.
85' The substitution is prepared. Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Joelinton.
85' Jason Tindall prepares a substitution. Bruno Guimaraes is replaced by Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd).

83' A neat pass is well received by Mason Mount (Manchester United), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
82' It's time for a substitution. Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) comes on in place of Bruno Fernandes.
78' Noussair Mazraoui goes off the pitch and Luke Shaw (Manchester United) comes on.
78' Substitution. Jacob Murphy makes way for Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd).
78' Jason Tindall decides to make a substitution. Kieran Trippier will be replaced by Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd).
78' The referee signals a substitution. Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) is brought on as a substitute for Alexander Isak.
77' The attendance is 52252.
77' 4 - 1 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom right corner. Good team effort!
76' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Altay Bayindir intercepts the ball.
75' Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Nick Pope easily deals with the threat.

73' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Chris Kavanagh blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Newcastle will take a free kick near the side line.
72' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
71' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Newcastle will take a corner kick.
70' Newcastle are ruled offside.
69' The free kick from long range, taken by Manchester Utd, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
69' Chris Kavanagh blows the whistle, Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) is penalised for a foul. Manchester Utd are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
68' Newcastle enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

64' 3 - 1 An amazing individual effort from Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the top right corner and makes it 3:1. Altay Bayindir was helpless.
62' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) serves up a nice cross, but Altay Bayindir punches the ball away.
61' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
60' Manchester Utd take a quick free kick and immediately restart play.
60' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) makes a slide tackle, but referee Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Manchester Utd.
58' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes it short.
58' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick.
58' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes a direct free kick.
57' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. That's a free kick to Newcastle.
55' Ruben Amorim is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) suffers an injury and Rasmus Hojlund comes on.
55' Ruben Amorim has decided to make a change. Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) replaces Harry Amass.
55' We are about to witness a substitution. Mason Mount (Manchester United) is replacing Alejandro Garnacho.
53' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
52' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
49' 2 - 1 Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) receives a killer pass and scores a great goal after finding the back of the net with a simple finish!
48' Harry Amass (Manchester United) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well over the bar.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.

45' A sweet pass finds Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the left side of the goal. Nick Pope is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
43' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
43' Leny Yoro (Manchester United) is awarded a yellow card.
40' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner but it's cleared.
39' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
39' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Good work from Newcastle as they win a corner.
37' 1 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Diogo Dalot sets up Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
37' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd).
35' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box found Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd), whose header floated just over the bar.
35' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
34' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Newcastle force a corner. They send men into the box.
34' A nice lofted cross finds Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) unmarked. He takes an excellent touch and gets in a shot that goes towards the middle of the net. An easy save for the goalkeeper, though.

32' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot into the bottom left corner, but Altay Bayindir makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
31' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
31' The free kick is taken short by Manchester Utd.
31' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) brings his opponent down. Chris Kavanagh has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester Utd win a free kick.
29' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
29' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner with a short pass.
28' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert. Newcastle get a corner.
27' Victor Lindelof (Manchester United) is penalised for holding. Chris Kavanagh signals a set piece. A free kick to Newcastle.
26' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

24' 1 - 0 Alexander Isak sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:0.
23' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post!
22' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
20' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
17' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
17' Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) is punished with the yellow card.
16' Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for an infringement.
15' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
14' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but Altay Bayindir comes off his line to gather the ball.
14' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd).
13' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) works the corner short.

12' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed under the crossbar, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. The ball goes behind for a corner. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
11' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Altay Bayindir.
10' Manchester Utd produce a short pass from the free kick.
10' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Manchester Utd get a free kick.
6' Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
4' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post.
3' A clumsy foul by Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle.
2' A goal, which was scored by Joelinton (Newcastle Utd), was disallowed due to offside.
1' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Manchester Utd will kick the game off.
Chris Kavanagh is introduced as the referee for today's match.
